UP.logic: Movement toward a higher point or limit

DOWN.logic: Movement toward a lower level or loss of energy

OFF.logic: Loss of contact or intentional separation

IN.logic: Being inside a system or activity

BACK.logic: Movement to a previous state or sender

FOR.logic: Movement toward a goal or beneficiary

diplomatic.label: DIPLOMATIC
diplomatic.desc: Soft contrast in meetings and professional emails

conversational.label: CONVERSATIONAL
conversational.desc: Spoken English and informal written contexts

V.en: to attract and engage someone's interest
V.es: Atraer y despertar el interés de alguien
V.ex: Her technical presentation drew the investors in immediately.

V.en: to avoid revealing information or emotions
V.es: Evitar revelar información o emociones
V.ex: During the negotiation he didn't give much away about the final price.

V.en: to not share information or feelings with others
V.es: No compartir información o sentimientos con otros
V.ex: He knew about the problem but kept it to himself until the board meeting.

V.en: a dramatic action designed to attract attention
V.es: Acción dramática diseñada para atraer atención mediática
V.ex: The environmental campaign was seen as a publicity stunt by some.

V.en: to profit from an opportunity or situation
V.es: Sacar partido de una oportunidad o situación
V.ex: They cashed in on the new recycling regulations early.

V.en: information spread through personal communication
V.es: Boca a boca — información difundida por comunicación personal
V.ex: Our scrapping business grew mainly through word of mouth.

V.en: to spread rapidly online reaching a large audience
V.es: Difundirse rápidamente en internet
V.ex: The video of our water treatment plant went viral online.

V.en: exaggerated publicity intended to create excitement
V.es: Publicidad exagerada para crear expectación
V.ex: There is a lot of hype around new membrane filtration technologies.

V.en: to meet expectations or standards set in advance
V.es: Cumplir expectativas o estándares previos
V.ex: The new treatment system lived up to its promised efficiency.

V.en: widely known for something bad or negative
V.es: Conocido ampliamente por algo negativo
V.ex: The site was notorious for its poor waste management practices.

V.en: clever and humorous in a quick, intelligent way
V.es: Ingenioso y agudo de forma inteligente y rápida
V.ex: His witty remarks eased the tension in the technical meeting.

V.en: complex, refined, and intelligently designed
V.es: Complejo, refinado e inteligentemente diseñado
V.ex: The new SCADA system is highly sophisticated.

V.en: to develop gradually over time through change
V.es: Desarrollarse gradualmente con el tiempo
V.ex: Environmental regulations continue to evolve across the EU.

V.en: to watch many episodes of a series consecutively
V.es: Ver muchos episodios seguidos en una sentada
V.ex: I binge-watched all the MBR technology webinars in one weekend.

V.en: ends a declarative sentence
V.es: Punto — termina una oración declarativa
V.ex: The effluent met all discharge standards.

V.en: introduces explanations, lists, or quotations
V.es: Dos puntos — introduce explicaciones, listas o citas
V.ex: The process includes three stages: coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation.

V.en: connects closely related independent clauses
V.es: Punto y coma — conecta dos cláusulas independientes relacionadas
V.ex: The pH was within range; however, turbidity remained high.

V.en: indicates interruption or a strong pause in text
V.es: Raya — indica interrupción o pausa fuerte en el texto
V.ex: The plant—despite its age—performed exceptionally well.

V.en: shows omission or trailing off in text
V.es: Puntos suspensivos — indica omisión o continuación
V.ex: The report mentioned several issues... but no solutions were given.

V.en: to consume or exhaust a resource completely
V.es: Consumir o agotar un recurso por completo
V.ex: We used up all the coagulant stock during the high-turbidity storm event.

V.en: to consume entirely; absorb too much time or resources
V.es: Consumir o absorber por completo (tiempo, recursos, presupuesto)
V.ex: Emergency maintenance ate up the entire quarterly maintenance budget.

V.en: to remove pollutants, improve or organise an area or process
V.es: Limpiar, descontaminar o mejorar un proceso o zona
V.ex: The team cleaned up the hydrocarbon spill within the containment bund.

V.en: to increase the rate or pace of a process
V.es: Acelerar el ritmo o la velocidad de un proceso
V.ex: We need to speed up the permit renewal process before the deadline.

V.en: to introduce a topic in a meeting or conversation
V.es: Plantear o sacar a colación un tema en una reunión
V.ex: She brought up the ASR disposal problem during the board meeting.

V.en: to arise or appear unexpectedly
V.es: Surgir o aparecer de forma inesperada
V.ex: A critical pump failure came up during the night shift.

V.en: to reach a final, often unplanned, outcome or situation
V.es: Acabar o terminar en una situación, a menudo imprevista
V.ex: If we delay the maintenance, we'll end up with a major compliance failure.

V.en: to stop trying; to abandon an effort or goal
V.es: Rendirse; abandonar un esfuerzo u objetivo
V.ex: We never give up on achieving our effluent quality targets.

V.en: to wear smart or formal clothes; also to wear a costume or disguise
V.es: Vestirse elegante o formal; también disfrazarse
V.ex: We had to dress up for the dinner with the client.
V.note: Contrario: 'dress down' (vestirse de forma informal). Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: to rise suddenly and quickly in amount, price or level
V.es: Dispararse; subir de golpe (precios, valores, temperaturas)
V.ex: Turbidity shot up from 5 to 80 NTU during the storm.
V.note: Irregular: shoot – shot – shot. Más intenso: 'skyrocket'. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: to reduce speed, rate, or intensity of a process
V.es: Reducir la velocidad o la intensidad de un proceso
V.ex: We slowed down the sludge recirculation rate to improve settling performance.

V.en: to reduce quantity, frequency, or size
V.es: Reducir la cantidad, frecuencia o tamaño de algo
V.ex: We need to cut down on chemical dosing costs by optimising the coagulation process.

V.en: to reject an offer, or to reduce intensity or volume
V.es: Rechazar una oferta o reducir la intensidad/volumen de algo
V.ex: The contractor turned down our initial budget proposal for the MBR upgrade.

V.en: to stop functioning; also to analyse something in detail
V.es: Dejar de funcionar; también: analizar en detalle
V.ex: The centrifuge broke down during peak sludge production on Friday night.

V.en: to stop operations completely, temporarily or permanently
V.es: Cerrar o parar las operaciones de forma total o temporal
V.ex: The plant was shut down for 48 hours due to an emergency electrical fault.

V.en: to disappoint someone by failing to meet their expectations
V.es: Decepcionar a alguien por no cumplir sus expectativas
V.ex: The supplier let us down with a two-week delay on the membrane delivery.

V.en: to record something in writing for future reference
V.es: Anotar o registrar algo por escrito para futura referencia
V.ex: Write down all pressure readings during the hydraulic pressure test.

V.en: to wear casual or less formal clothes than usual
V.es: Vestirse de forma informal o más relajada
V.ex: On Fridays everyone at the office dresses down.
V.note: Contrario de 'dress up'. Ojo: 'dress someone down' (con objeto) = reprender duramente. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: to have nothing left of a resource or supply
V.es: Quedarse sin existencias o suministro de algo
V.ex: We ran out of ferric sulphate during the prolonged heavy rainfall event.

V.en: to discover or obtain information about something
V.es: Averiguar o descubrir información sobre algo
V.ex: We need to find out why the effluent turbidity is rising unexpectedly.

V.en: to understand or solve something after careful reflection
V.es: Entender o resolver algo tras reflexión o análisis técnico
V.ex: The team figured out the root cause of the membrane fouling issue.

V.en: to eliminate something as a possibility or option
V.es: Descartar algo como posibilidad u opción técnica
V.ex: We ruled out biological failure as the cause of the elevated BOD in the effluent.

V.en: to execute or perform a task, plan, or inspection
V.es: Ejecutar o llevar a cabo una tarea, plan o inspección
V.ex: The depollution inspection was carried out by a certified ELV operator.

V.en: to gradually eliminate or discontinue something over time
V.es: Eliminar o retirar gradualmente algo con el tiempo
V.ex: HFCs in vehicle air conditioning are being phased out under EU F-Gas Regulation.

V.en: to be clearly noticeable or better than others
V.es: Destacar o ser claramente superior o notable
V.ex: Our depollution process stands out for its compliance record in Asturias.

V.en: to disconnect power or stop a device from operating
V.es: Apagar o desconectar la alimentación de un equipo
V.ex: Turn off the chemical dosing pump before performing any maintenance work.

V.en: to cancel a planned event or activity
V.es: Cancelar un evento o actividad planificada
V.ex: The site audit was called off due to the red weather alert.

V.en: to postpone or delay something to a later time
V.es: Aplazar o posponer algo para más adelante
V.ex: We cannot put off the ELV permit renewal any longer — the deadline is Friday.

V.en: to disconnect or sever completely; to interrupt a supply
V.es: Cortar o desconectar por completo; interrumpir el suministro
V.ex: The power was cut off during the grid fault, stopping all treatment processes.

V.en: to dismiss employees, usually for economic reasons
V.es: Despedir a empleados, generalmente por razones económicas
V.ex: The plant restructuring resulted in laying off 12 operational staff members.

V.en: to withdraw pressure or retreat from a position
V.es: Dar marcha atrás; retirarse de una posición o aflojar la presión
V.ex: The regulator backed off after reviewing our full compliance documentation.

V.en: to produce a positive result after effort or investment
V.es: Dar sus frutos; producir un resultado positivo tras el esfuerzo
V.ex: The investment in MBR technology paid off within the first five years.

V.en: to continue doing something without stopping
V.es: Continuar haciendo algo sin detenerse
V.ex: We must carry on with the treatment process despite the heavy rainfall event.

V.en: to continue or to happen over a period of time
V.es: Continuar o suceder durante un período de tiempo
V.ex: The discharge violation went on for three days before it was detected by the SCADA.

V.en: to develop, improve, or actively address something
V.es: Trabajar en algo; desarrollar o mejorar activamente
V.ex: We are working on improving our NRW reduction strategy this quarter.

V.en: to rely on someone or something with confidence
V.es: Contar con; confiar en alguien o algo con seguridad
V.ex: We can count on the SCADA system to alert us to any process anomaly immediately.

V.en: to accept or assume a new task, challenge, or responsibility
V.es: Asumir una nueva tarea, reto o responsabilidad
V.ex: The new environmental manager took on the ELV compliance project last month.

V.en: to progress to the next stage or topic
V.es: Pasar al siguiente punto o etapa; avanzar
V.ex: Now that the audit report is finalised, let's move on to the next priority item.

V.en: to place clothing or protective equipment on your body
V.es: Ponerse una prenda o un equipo de protección
V.ex: Put on your safety helmet before entering the treatment area.
V.note: Contrario: 'take off'. Distinto de 'get dressed' (vestirse). Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: to participate in an activity or discussion
V.es: Unirse o participar en una actividad o discusión
V.ex: All department heads should join in the environmental compliance training sessions.

V.en: to involve someone new in a project or process
V.es: Incorporar a alguien nuevo en un proyecto o proceso
V.ex: We brought in an external specialist consultant for the environmental impact assessment.

V.en: to participate actively in something
V.es: Involucrarse activamente en algo
V.ex: All staff should get involved in the new ISO 14001 certification process.

V.en: to make something fixed and unchangeable; to secure an agreement
V.es: Fijar o asegurar un acuerdo de forma inamovible
V.ex: The long-term supply contract locked in the chemical price for three years.

V.en: to begin to have an effect or come into force
V.es: Entrar en vigor; comenzar a surtir efecto
V.ex: The main obligations of the new EU ELV Regulation (EU) 2026/1738 will kick in from September 2028.

V.en: to submit something formally to an authority or supervisor
V.es: Entregar formalmente algo a una autoridad o supervisor
V.ex: Please hand in all depollution records before the scheduled compliance audit.

V.en: to transmit or send files, documents, or information
V.es: Enviar documentos, archivos o información a alguien
V.ex: Could you send over the latest effluent quality analysis report by this afternoon?

V.en: to review or examine something carefully and in detail
V.es: Revisar o examinar algo detalladamente y con cuidado
V.ex: Let's go over the tender documents together before submitting the bid.

V.en: to review something quickly and informally
V.es: Revisar algo rápidamente y de forma informal
V.ex: Can you look over the P&ID before the contractor arrives on site tomorrow?

V.en: to redo something that was done incorrectly
V.es: Repetir o rehacer algo que se hizo de forma incorrecta
V.ex: The hydraulic calculations had errors, so we had to do them over entirely.

V.en: to assume control, ownership, or responsibility from someone else
V.es: Asumir el control, la propiedad o la responsabilidad de algo
V.ex: The new operator will take over plant management from 1st March.

V.en: to make something unnecessarily complex
V.es: Complicar algo en exceso de forma innecesaria
V.ex: Don't overcomplicate the BOQ — keep each item clear and measurable.

V.en: to reply to someone later when you have more information
V.es: Volver a contactar cuando se tenga más información
V.ex: I'll get back to you on the ELV regulation query by end of the week.

V.en: to return something to where or whom it came from
V.es: Devolver algo al lugar o persona de origen
V.ex: The defective membrane modules were sent back to the manufacturer for replacement.

V.en: to return a telephone call to someone
V.es: Devolver una llamada telefónica a alguien
V.ex: Please call back when you have the updated pressure test results available.

V.en: to resist, oppose, or argue against a proposal
V.es: Resistir, oponerse o rebatir una propuesta o decisión
V.ex: The municipality pushed back on the proposed water tariff increase of 15%.

V.en: to reverse a recent change or return to a previous state
V.es: Revertir un cambio reciente o volver a un estado anterior
V.ex: The contractor requested to roll back the last SCADA configuration update.

V.en: to revisit a topic, issue, or previous point in a discussion
V.es: Volver a tratar un tema o punto anterior en una discusión
V.ex: Let's go back to the issue of the elevated TSS in last week's effluent sample.

V.en: to request something formally or informally
V.es: Solicitar algo de forma formal o informal
V.ex: We asked for an extension of the ELV compliance implementation deadline.

V.en: to formally request a permit, position, or grant
V.es: Solicitar formalmente un permiso, puesto o subvención
V.ex: We applied for a new discharge permit under the revised Water Framework Directive.

V.en: to search or try to find something or someone
V.es: Buscar algo o a alguien de forma activa
V.ex: We are looking for a certified ELV depollution operator for the Asturias facility.

V.en: to take over someone's duties temporarily while absent
V.es: Cubrir o sustituir a alguien en sus funciones de forma temporal
V.ex: Ana is covering for the plant manager while he is on annual leave.

V.en: to act as a replacement for someone in a role or meeting
V.es: Sustituir a alguien en un cargo o reunión específica
V.ex: He stood in for the director at the EU Water Industry Forum in Brussels.

V.en: polite phrase providing supporting documents in an email
V.es: Para su referencia — fórmula al adjuntar documentación de apoyo
V.ex: I'm attaching the latest COD analysis data for your reference.

V.en: phrase indicating a document requires authorisation
V.es: Para aprobación — indica que un documento requiere autorización
V.ex: The tender technical specifications are attached for approval by the committee.

V.en: phrase requesting someone to check or assess a document
V.es: Para revisión — solicita que alguien evalúe o revise un documento
V.ex: Please find the draft EIA report attached for review and comments.

V.en: to collaborate or cooperate with someone toward a shared goal
V.es: Colaborar o cooperar con alguien hacia un objetivo común
V.ex: We work with a certified hazardous waste management company for all ELV fluids.

V.en: to align actions or plans with another person or team
V.es: Coordinarse con otra persona o equipo para alinear acciones
V.ex: Please coordinate with the laboratory team on the weekly sampling schedule.

V.en: to share or support another person's opinion or position
V.es: Estar de acuerdo con la opinión o posición de otra persona
V.ex: I agree with the proposed changes to the chemical dosing protocol.

V.en: to handle, manage, or resolve a problem or situation
V.es: Manejar, gestionar o resolver un problema o situación
V.ex: The operations team dealt with the emergency spill effectively within 2 hours.

V.en: to accept, approve, or feel at ease with something
V.es: Estar conforme con algo; aceptarlo o sentirse cómodo con ello
V.ex: Are you comfortable with the new effluent reporting format for the regulator?

V.en: to be formally assigned a specific responsibility or task
V.es: Ser formalmente asignado con una responsabilidad o tarea específica
V.ex: Our team is tasked with achieving the EU ELV 95% recovery target this year.

V.en: Formal contrast connector — introduces a contradicting statement despite what was just acknowledged
V.es: Sin embargo / No obstante (formal) — introduce una contradicción a pesar de lo reconocido
V.ex: The treatment plant exceeded COD limits last quarter. Nevertheless, overall environmental compliance has improved significantly.

V.en: Formal contrast; very close to 'nevertheless' — used after acknowledging a clear fact
V.es: No obstante / Aun así (formal) — muy similar a 'nevertheless'; reconoce un hecho y contrasta
V.ex: The new ELV regulations impose significant operational costs. Nonetheless, we are committed to full compliance by January.

V.en: The most common formal contrast connector in professional and technical writing
V.es: Sin embargo (formal) — el conector de contraste más frecuente en escritura profesional
V.ex: Effluent BOD met the permit limit. However, TSS was slightly above the authorised threshold.
V.structure: Statement A. However, statement B. / Statement A, however, statement B.

V.en: Soft diplomatic contrast: acknowledges the previous point fully before introducing a nuanced counterpoint
V.es: Dicho esto / No obstante (diplomático) — reconoce el punto previo y añade un matiz con suavidad
V.ex: The ELV recycling rate meets current EU targets. That being said, further improvements are achievable with selective dismantling.
V.structure: Statement A. That being said, statement B.

V.en: Neutral-formal contrast; indicates contradiction or a surprising counterpoint — common in formal writing
V.es: Sin embargo / Pero (neutro-formal) — indica contradicción o sorpresa; frecuente en escritura
V.ex: The process is well-established. Yet, recent performance data suggest room for further optimisation.
V.structure: Statement A. Yet, statement B. / Statement A, yet statement B.

V.en: The most basic and universal contrast connector — natural in speech and informal writing
V.es: Pero (neutro/coloquial) — el conector de contraste más básico y universal
V.ex: The valve was inspected last month, but no signs of wear were detected.

V.en: Conversational contrast — acknowledges a real obstacle or fact but introduces a positive counterpoint
V.es: Aun así (coloquial) — reconoce un obstáculo real pero introduce un contrapunto positivo
V.ex: The pump is approaching the end of its design life. Even so, it continues to perform within the design parameters.
V.structure: Statement A. Even so, statement B.

V.en: Conversational contrast — indicates something remains valid or true despite the previous point
V.es: Aun así / De todas formas (informal) — algo sigue siendo cierto pese a lo anterior
V.ex: The membrane flux has dropped by 15%. Still, the system is consistently meeting effluent quality targets.

V.en: Basic conjunction joining two equal ideas or items
V.es: y — conjunción básica que une dos ideas o elementos de igual peso
V.ex: The effluent was treated and discharged within the permitted limits.

V.en: Adds an additional point to what has already been said
V.es: también — añade un punto adicional a lo ya mencionado
V.ex: The plant needs a new dosing pump. It also requires a membrane inspection this quarter.

V.en: Placed at end of clause to add another point; informal alternative to 'also'
V.es: también / además — al final de la cláusula; alternativa informal a 'also'
V.ex: We need to renew the ELV permit. We should update the depollution records as well.

V.en: Informal addition connector used at the end of a clause or sentence
V.es: también — conector informal al final de la cláusula o frase
V.ex: The COD results were satisfactory. The BOD levels were within limits too.

V.en: Formal addition that strengthens or builds on the previous point
V.es: además / es más (formal) — refuerza o desarrolla el punto anterior
V.ex: The MBR system reduces energy consumption. Moreover, it produces effluent suitable for reuse.

V.en: Formal addition introducing a new and separate supporting point
V.es: además / asimismo (formal) — introduce un punto de apoyo nuevo y separado
V.ex: The ELV facility meets all safety requirements. Furthermore, it exceeds the EU 85% recycling target.

V.en: Formal addition connector introducing a supplementary idea or requirement
V.es: además (formal) — introduce una idea o requisito suplementario
V.ex: Fluids must be drained. In addition, pyrotechnic devices must be safely deactivated.

V.en: Formal/neutral addition; similar to 'in addition' but more compact
V.es: adicionalmente — similar a 'in addition', más compacto
V.ex: The COD target was achieved. Additionally, turbidity was reduced by 97%.

V.en: Emphatic addition showing two connected advantages or facts
V.es: no solo ... sino también — enfatiza dos hechos o ventajas conectados
V.ex: The MBR not only removes suspended solids but also eliminates pathogens from the effluent.

V.en: Introduces a subordinate clause expressing contrast or concession; formal and neutral
V.es: aunque — introduce una cláusula subordinada de contraste o concesión
V.ex: Although the pH was within range, the turbidity remained above the permit threshold.

V.en: Similar to 'although' but less formal; can also appear at the end of a sentence
V.es: aunque — similar a 'although' pero menos formal; puede ir al final de la oración
V.ex: The pump performed well, though the energy consumption was higher than expected.

V.en: Stronger than 'although' — emphasises the contrast despite a strong opposing fact
V.es: a pesar de que — más fuerte que 'although'; enfatiza el contraste ante un hecho opuesto fuerte
V.ex: Even though the membrane was new, fouling occurred within just three weeks.

V.en: Formal contrast showing a clear difference between two parallel facts or situations
V.es: mientras que (formal) — diferencia clara entre dos hechos o situaciones paralelos
V.ex: Ferric sulphate achieves rapid coagulation, whereas aluminium sulphate requires longer contact time.

V.en: Expresses contrast between two parallel situations; similar to 'whereas'
V.es: mientras que (contraste) — contraste entre dos situaciones paralelas; similar a 'whereas'
V.ex: While the primary treatment met standards, the secondary stage showed significant underperformance.

V.en: Neutral contrast introducing an opposing or balancing viewpoint
V.es: por otro lado — introduce un punto de vista opuesto o equilibrante
V.ex: Biological treatment is cost-effective. On the other hand, it requires careful process monitoring.

V.en: Formal contrast highlighting a significant difference between two data sets or situations
V.es: en contraste — diferencia significativa entre dos situaciones o conjuntos de datos
V.ex: The influent BOD was 320 mg/L. In contrast, the treated effluent measured only 18 mg/L.

V.en: Introduces the direct reason or cause of a result; clause follows
V.es: porque — introduce la razón o causa directa de un resultado
V.ex: The nitrification process slowed down because the dissolved oxygen dropped below 1.5 mg/L.

V.en: Introduces a noun phrase as the cause; followed by a noun, not a clause
V.es: debido a — introduce un sustantivo como causa (no una cláusula completa)
V.ex: The treatment efficiency dropped because of an unexpected increase in influent organic load.

V.en: Introduces a reason — often implying the listener already knows the cause
V.es: puesto que / ya que — introduce una razón conocida por el interlocutor
V.ex: Since the pH was below 6.5, the nitrification bacteria became inactive immediately.

V.en: Introduces a reason or simultaneous action; slightly more formal than 'because'
V.es: ya que — introduce una razón o acción simultánea; más formal que 'because'
V.ex: As the dissolved oxygen was insufficient, the biological degradation process stalled.

V.en: Introduces the result or consequence of the previous statement; informal
V.es: así que — introduce el resultado o consecuencia del enunciado anterior; informal
V.ex: The membrane fouling was severe, so we initiated an emergency chemical cleaning cycle.

V.en: Formal connector introducing a logical conclusion from the previous statement
V.es: por lo tanto (formal) — conclusión lógica del enunciado anterior
V.ex: The effluent TSS exceeded the permit limit. Therefore, the discharge was temporarily suspended.

V.en: Formal/academic connector meaning 'as a result of this' or 'in this way'
V.es: así / por consiguiente (formal/académico) — 'como resultado de esto'
V.ex: The sludge age was increased to 20 days, thus ensuring stable and complete nitrification.

V.en: Formal result connector showing one event directly caused another
V.es: en consecuencia (formal) — un evento causó directamente otro
V.ex: The primary pump failed during the night shift. Consequently, the plant operated at reduced capacity.

V.en: Neutral-formal connector introducing the direct outcome of the previous situation
V.es: como resultado — introduce el resultado directo de la situación anterior
V.ex: The coagulant dose was optimised. As a result, effluent turbidity dropped below 0.5 NTU.

V.en: Introduces a noun phrase as the cause; formal and common in technical writing
V.es: debido a (formal) — introduce un sustantivo como causa; frecuente en escritura técnica
V.ex: The discharge permit was exceeded due to an unexpected storm inflow event.

V.en: The simplest way to express purpose; followed by the base verb
V.es: para (+ infinitivo) — la forma más simple de expresar propósito
V.ex: We installed a flow meter to monitor the influent discharge rate accurately.

V.en: More formal alternative to 'to'; clearly emphasises the intended purpose
V.es: para (formal) — alternativa más formal a 'to'; enfatiza el propósito intencionado
V.ex: The SRT was extended to 25 days in order to achieve stable nitrification at low temperatures.

V.en: Formal/neutral alternative to 'in order to'; used mainly in writing
V.es: para (formal) — alternativa a 'in order to'; principalmente en escritura
V.ex: The valve was closed slowly so as to avoid a water hammer event in the rising main.

V.en: Introduces a purpose clause with subject + verb; result is the intended goal
V.es: para que — introduce una cláusula de propósito con sujeto + verbo
V.ex: The aeration rate was increased so that dissolved oxygen remained above 2 mg/L at all times.

V.en: Formal alternative to 'so that'; used in legal or technical documents
V.es: para que (formal) — alternativa a 'so that'; frecuente en documentos técnicos o legales
V.ex: Records must be retained for five years in order that the regulator may inspect them at any time.

V.en: Refers to a specific time or moment at which something happens
V.es: cuando — se refiere a un momento específico en que algo ocurre
V.ex: When the pH drops below 6.5, the dosing system activates automatically.

V.en: Refers to any time or every time a condition is met; repeated action
V.es: siempre que / cada vez que — cualquier momento en que se cumpla una condición
V.ex: Whenever the turbidity exceeds 5 NTU, the coagulant dosing rate increases automatically.

V.en: Indicates two actions happening simultaneously; dual use: also means contrast
V.es: mientras — dos acciones simultáneas (también indica contraste según contexto)
V.ex: While the centrifuge was running, the maintenance team inspected the blower unit.

V.en: Indicates that one action occurs prior to another in time
V.es: antes de — indica que una acción ocurre con anterioridad a otra
V.ex: Before starting the pump, always verify that the discharge valve is fully open.

V.en: Indicates that one action follows another in time
V.es: después de — indica que una acción sigue a otra en el tiempo
V.ex: After depollution is complete, the vehicle can be safely transferred to the shredder.

V.en: Indicates that something happens within a specified time period
V.es: durante — algo ocurre dentro de un período de tiempo específico
V.ex: During the storm event, the influent flow exceeded three times the design capacity.

V.en: Indicates the next step or action in a sequence
V.es: entonces / luego — indica el siguiente paso en una secuencia
V.ex: First the fluids are drained. Then the battery and pyrotechnic devices are removed safely.

V.en: Introduces the following step or event in an ordered sequence
V.es: a continuación — introduce el siguiente paso en una secuencia ordenada
V.ex: First check the valve position. Next, confirm the pump speed setting on the SCADA screen.

V.en: Introduces the last step in a sequence; also used to close an argument
V.es: finalmente — introduce el último paso de una secuencia; también cierra un argumento
V.ex: Finally, the vehicle is weighed and the Certificate of Destruction is issued to the owner.

V.en: Refers to something that happens after a long time or series of events
V.es: finalmente / con el tiempo — algo que ocurre tras un largo proceso o serie de eventos
V.ex: After several optimisation trials, the plant eventually achieved stable phosphorus removal below 1 mg/L.

V.en: Indicates that two events are happening at the same time in parallel
V.es: mientras tanto — dos eventos ocurren en paralelo al mismo tiempo
V.ex: The main pump was being repaired. Meanwhile, the backup unit maintained full treatment capacity.

V.en: Introduces a condition that must be true for the result to follow
V.es: si — la condición debe cumplirse para que el resultado ocurra
V.ex: If the effluent fails the quality check, the discharge valve closes automatically.

V.en: Means 'if not' — introduces the only condition that would prevent the result
V.es: a menos que — 'si no'; la única condición que evitaría el resultado
V.ex: The ELV permit cannot be renewed unless all depollution records are fully up to date.

V.en: Introduces a condition that must be maintained continuously for a result to occur
V.es: siempre que — condición que debe mantenerse de forma continua
V.ex: The biological process will remain stable as long as dissolved oxygen stays above 2 mg/L.

V.en: Formal condition connector meaning 'on the condition that'
V.es: con tal de que (formal) — 'a condición de que'; frecuente en contratos y documentos
V.ex: The contractor may begin work provided that all risk assessments have been approved.

V.en: Introduces a precautionary action — taken to prevent a possible future problem
V.es: en caso de que — acción preventiva para evitar un posible problema futuro
V.ex: Keep the backup generator fuelled in case the main grid supply fails overnight.

V.en: Introduces the negative consequence if the condition is not met; means 'if not'
V.es: de lo contrario — consecuencia negativa si no se cumple la condición
V.ex: The dosing pump must be calibrated monthly. Otherwise, the chemical dose will drift out of specification.

V.en: Introduces a comparison using a noun or noun phrase (informal)
V.es: como — introduce una comparación con un sustantivo (informal)
V.ex: The secondary clarifier behaves like a settling tank under low-flow conditions.

V.en: Formal comparison connector; also used in 'as...as' equality structures
V.es: como (formal) — comparación formal; también en estructuras 'tan...como'
V.ex: The new membrane performed as expected during the first commissioning trial.

V.en: Expresses equal degree or quantity between two things
V.es: tan ... como — expresa igualdad de grado o cantidad entre dos cosas
V.ex: The MBR effluent quality was as consistent as predicted by the design hydraulic model.

V.en: Used with comparative adjectives to show a difference in degree
V.es: que — usado con adjetivos comparativos para indicar diferencia de grado
V.ex: The RO permeate quality was significantly better than the target specification.

V.en: Formal connector showing that two things are alike or share comparable features
V.es: de manera similar (formal) — dos cosas comparten características comparables
V.ex: The nitrification kinetics followed the Monod model. Similarly, denitrification matched the predicted rate.

V.en: Formal/neutral; means 'in the same way'; used to add a parallel point
V.es: del mismo modo (formal) — añade un punto paralelo; 'de la misma manera'
V.ex: Primary sedimentation achieved 65% TSS removal. Likewise, the flotation unit met its design target.

V.en: Neutral connector indicating two processes or actions follow the same pattern
V.es: de la misma manera — dos procesos o acciones siguen el mismo patrón
V.ex: In the same way that a WTP reduces turbidity, an MBR eliminates suspended solids from wastewater.

V.en: Introduces a specific instance or illustration of a general statement
V.es: por ejemplo — introduce un caso o ilustración específica de una afirmación general
V.ex: Several parameters must be monitored daily — for example, pH, dissolved oxygen, and turbidity.

V.en: Neutral/formal alternative to 'for example'; used in writing and speech
V.es: por ejemplo — alternativa formal a 'for example'; oral y escrito
V.ex: Hazardous ELV components, for instance airbags and refrigerants, require specialist handling.

V.en: Introduces specific examples within a list; followed directly by the example noun
V.es: como por ejemplo — introduce ejemplos específicos en una lista; seguido de sustantivo
V.ex: Precious metals such as platinum, palladium and rhodium are recovered from catalytic converters.

V.en: Formal connector specifying exactly what was referred to; introduces a precise list
V.es: es decir / a saber (formal) — especifica exactamente a qué se refería; lista precisa
V.ex: Two parameters exceeded the discharge limit, namely BOD and total suspended solids.

V.en: Clarifies or rephrases what was just said; introduces a more precise restatement
V.es: es decir (i.e.) — aclara o reformula lo dicho con mayor precisión
V.ex: The membrane was operated at maximum flux, that is, 25 litres per square metre per hour.

V.en: Introduces a simpler or more accessible rephrasing of the previous statement
V.es: en otras palabras — reformulación más simple del enunciado anterior
V.ex: The COD/BOD ratio exceeded 0.5. In other words, the wastewater was not readily biodegradable.

V.en: Formal emphasis connector confirming or strengthening a previous statement
V.es: de hecho (formal) — confirma o refuerza un enunciado anterior con énfasis
V.ex: The MBR system was efficient. Indeed, it exceeded all performance guarantees in the first year.

V.en: Introduces a surprising or stronger truth compared to what was expected
V.es: de hecho — introduce una verdad sorprendente o más fuerte de lo esperado
V.ex: The ELV process looked simple. In fact, it involves over 30 individual regulated steps.

V.en: Highlights the single most important point among several mentioned
V.es: sobre todo — destaca el punto más importante entre varios mencionados
V.ex: The process must be safe, efficient, and cost-effective. Above all, it must comply with EU regulations.

V.en: Highlights one particular element as more important than the others
V.es: especialmente — destaca un elemento particular como más importante que los demás
V.ex: Monitoring is critical for all process parameters, especially dissolved oxygen in the bioreactor.

V.en: Formal emphasis; singles out one item as particularly relevant or significant
V.es: particularmente (formal) — destaca un elemento como especialmente relevante
V.ex: The regulation affects all treatment plants, particularly those discharging into sensitive water bodies.

V.en: Formal connector opening the final summary or closing statement of a document
V.es: en conclusión (formal) — introduce el resumen final o conclusión de un documento
V.ex: In conclusion, the WWTP upgrade meets all current EU effluent quality standards.

V.en: Formal connector used to introduce the final remark in a report or presentation
V.es: para concluir (formal) — introduce la observación final de un informe o presentación
V.ex: To conclude, selective dismantling is the most effective route to achieving the EU 95% ELV recovery target.

V.en: Introduces a brief overview of the key points already covered
V.es: en resumen — introduce una visión general breve de los puntos ya tratados
V.ex: In summary, the water treatment plant achieved all three performance targets this quarter.

V.en: Informal/neutral way to introduce a final summary; common in spoken English
V.es: en resumen (informal/neutro) — resumen final; muy común en inglés oral
V.ex: To sum up, we need to replace two pumps, upgrade the SCADA system, and renew the operating permit.

V.en: Introduces a general assessment taking all factors into account
V.es: en general / en conjunto — evaluación general teniendo en cuenta todos los factores
V.ex: Overall, the ELV depollution process met all regulatory requirements during the annual inspection.

V.en: Use 'whether' for choices, alternatives, or indirect questions — NOT for conditions
V.es: 'Whether' para opciones, alternativas o preguntas indirectas — NO para condiciones
V.ex: We need to determine whether the membrane should be replaced or cleaned in place.
V.rule: ✓ Whether OR... | ✓ Indirect questions | ✓ After prepositions | ✗ NOT for conditions

V.en: Use 'if' for conditions — the result depends on the condition being true (NOT for choices)
V.es: 'If' para condiciones — el resultado depende de que la condición sea verdadera (NO para opciones)
V.ex: If the pH drops below 6.5, the nitrification process will be inhibited.
V.rule: ✓ Conditions | ✓ Hypothetical situations | ✗ NOT for choices or alternatives

V.en: The regular past ending -ed has three sounds, chosen by the final SOUND of the verb (not its last letter)
V.es: La terminación -ed del pasado regular tiene tres sonidos según el SONIDO final del verbo (no la letra final)
V.ex: The effluent was treated /ɪd/, the pump was checked /t/ and the tank was cleaned /d/.
V.rule: /ɪd/ after /t/ or /d/ (wanted, ended) | /t/ after voiceless sounds (hoped, laughed, relaxed, washed, watched, liked) | /d/ after all other sounds (played, allowed, begged)

V.en: Producing or full of unwanted, loud, or unpleasant sound
V.es: Ruidoso — que produce o está lleno de sonido no deseado o molesto
V.ex: The old centrifuge is extremely noisy during the sludge dewatering cycle.

V.en: Too curious or interested in other people's private matters; intrusive
V.es: Entrometido — excesivamente curioso sobre los asuntos privados ajenos
V.ex: He was being rather nosy about the contractor's tender price, which was not his concern.

V.en: A very large, indefinite number — used to express frustration at constant repetition
V.es: Muchísimas (veces) — número indefinido muy grande; expresa frustración por repetición
V.ex: I've updated the ELV compliance report umpteen times this month and the figures keep changing.
V.note: Related form: 'umpteenth' → 'For the umpteenth time, please check the valve settings.'

V.en: Approximately; around a certain number, time, or amount (British English informal)
V.es: Aproximadamente; alrededor de — inglés británico informal
V.ex: The full depollution process for one vehicle takes round about 45 minutes.
V.note: More formal equivalents: 'approximately', 'around', 'roughly'

V.en: (1) To wash the whole body in water | (2) To clean or soak a wound | (3) Figurative: to be covered or flooded with light
V.es: (1) Bañarse | (2) Limpiar o aplicar líquido en una herida | (3) Figurado: estar bañado de luz
V.ex: The nurse bathed the wound carefully with saline. / The treatment plant was bathed in morning sunlight.
V.note: Not to be confused with 'bath' (noun: the container) or 'bathroom'

V.en: To rise extremely fast and by a very large amount (prices, costs, values)
V.es: Dispararse por las nubes; subir como un cohete (precios, costes, valores)
V.ex: Energy costs skyrocketed last winter.
V.note: Ortografía: sky + rocket + ed (no 'skyroketed'). Regular: skyrocketed /ˈskaɪˌrɒkɪtɪd/. Más intenso que 'shoot up'. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: (verb) to promote or praise something strongly, often exaggerating | (noun) a person who pesters people to buy, or resells tickets at inflated prices
V.es: (verbo) promocionar o alabar algo con insistencia, a veces exagerando | (sust.) captador insistente; revendedor de entradas
V.ex: The supplier touts the new membrane as the most efficient on the market.
V.note: Como verbo suele llevar matiz escéptico (parecido a 'hype'). Estructura: tout + objeto + as + cualidad. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: Having a lot of money; also (of things) containing a lot of something, e.g. rich soil
V.es: Rico — con mucho dinero; también 'rico en' algo (suelo rico, rico en nutrientes)
V.ex: He is rich because he sold his company.
V.note: Colectivo: 'the rich'. Sirve para personas y cosas. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: Having a lot of money AND assets; richness that is accumulated, stable and lasting
V.es: Adinerado, de gran patrimonio — riqueza acumulada, estable y duradera
V.ex: A wealthy family owns the land around the reservoir.
V.confusionWith: RICH (mucho dinero, más directo y común)
V.note: Ortografía: wealthy (de 'wealth'), no 'welthy'. Más formal que 'rich'. Solo personas, familias o países. Colectivo: 'the wealthy'. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: Having enough money to live comfortably; in a good financial position (milder than rich)
V.es: Acomodado — con buena posición económica, sin lujos extremos
V.ex: His family is quite well off, so he never worried about tuition fees.
V.note: Escala: well off < rich < wealthy. Con guion antes de sustantivo: 'a well-off family'. Colectivo: 'the well-off'. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: (noun) market stands or booths | (verb) engine stops working | (verb) deliberately delays progress
V.es: (sust.) puestos de mercado | (verb.) el motor se cala | (verb.) dar largas, retrasar a propósito
V.ex: The car engine stalled at the lights. / The negotiation stalled because neither side would move.
V.note: Three uses: physical stall (market), mechanical stall (engine), strategic stall (delay)

V.en: (1) Socially uncomfortable or embarrassing | (2) Difficult to handle or deal with | (3) Clumsy in movement
V.es: (1) Incómodo socialmente | (2) Difícil de manejar | (3) Torpe en movimiento
V.ex: There was an awkward silence after he mentioned the failed project in front of the client.
V.note: Key nuance: 'awkward' is milder and more neutral than 'cringe' — it does not imply disgust

V.en: A strong feeling of embarrassment — often second-hand embarrassment watching someone else. Informal adj: 'cringeworthy'
V.es: Vergüenza ajena intensa — o vergüenza propia muy fuerte. Adjetivo informal: 'cringeworthy'
V.ex: I cringed when he tried to tell that joke in the meeting. It was so cringe.
V.note: Stronger and more emotional than 'awkward'. Often implies the situation is painful to watch or remember

V.en: Showing signs of future success or high potential; encouraging early results
V.es: Prometedor — que muestra señales de éxito futuro o alto potencial
V.ex: The pilot test results are promising — effluent quality exceeded the design specification.
V.note: Positive word: use when something looks good but is not yet confirmed. NOT the same as 'guaranteed'

V.term: get your foot in the door
V.en: To gain an initial opportunity or entry-level position with potential to grow from there
V.es: Meter el pie en la puerta — conseguir una primera oportunidad aunque sea modesta
V.ex: He accepted a junior technician role to get his foot in the door at the water company.
V.note: Often used for jobs, business, or relationships. Focus is on the START — not the final outcome

V.en: (1) Moved slowly without control or direction | (2) Gradually changed in attitude, focus, or location | (3) Lost purpose over time
V.es: (1) Moverse lentamente sin control | (2) Cambiar gradualmente de actitud o enfoque | (3) Perder el rumbo con el tiempo
V.ex: After the plant closed, he drifted between temporary jobs for two years without a clear plan.
V.note: Implies slowness and lack of intentional direction — different from 'moved' or 'changed' which imply choice

V.en: (1) Set free from confinement | (2) Made available to the public (film, report, product) | (3) Let go of pressure or tension
V.es: (1) Puesto en libertad | (2) Publicado o lanzado al público | (3) Liberado (tensión, presión)
V.ex: The environmental impact report was finally released after three months of internal review.
V.note: Very common in professional contexts: 'The report was released', 'The update was released'

V.en: Failed badly or completely — especially a product, film, or plan that did not meet expectations at all
V.es: Fracasó estrepitosamente — un producto, película o plan que no cumplió ninguna expectativa
V.ex: The new water recycling product flopped — sales were less than 5% of the forecast in the first quarter.
V.note: Stronger than 'failed'. Implies the failure was public, clear, and disappointing. Very informal.

V.en: To return to a realistic, practical view of a situation after being overly optimistic or idealistic
V.es: Volver a la realidad — dejar de pensar de forma poco realista o demasiado optimista
V.ex: After the audit results came in, the team came back down to earth about the project timeline.
V.note: Often used after a period of excitement or overconfidence. Gentle, not harsh in tone.

V.en: Trapped in a boring, repetitive routine with no progress or change — stagnation in work or life
V.es: Estancado en una rutina — atrapado en una monotonía sin avance ni cambio
V.ex: After five years doing the same process checks, he felt completely stuck in a rut.
V.note: A 'rut' is literally a groove worn into a road by wheels. Figuratively: you keep going the same way

V.en: Barely managing to survive financially or cope with a situation — with the minimum necessary resources
V.es: Arreglárselas a duras penas — sobrevivir con lo mínimo, a punto del límite
V.ex: After the contract ended, the company was scraping by on emergency maintenance work alone.
V.note: More desperate than 'getting by' — implies genuine struggle, not just modesty

V.en: An extremely tall building, typically in an urban environment; a defining feature of modern city skylines
V.es: Rascacielos — edificio extremadamente alto, típico del entorno urbano moderno
V.ex: The new headquarters is a 45-floor skyscraper in the financial district of Madrid.
V.note: Literal compound: 'scrape the sky'. No figurative common use — purely architectural

V.en: To manage to live, survive, or cope — especially with limited resources or in a difficult situation
V.es: Arreglárselas — sobrevivir o manejarse, especialmente con recursos limitados
V.ex: With the budget cuts, the maintenance team had to get by with half the usual spare parts stock.
V.note: Neutral tone — implies adequacy, not comfort. Less desperate than 'scraping by'

V.en: For digital actions: fine and natural. For social 'clicked' (bonding with someone): use 'immediately clicked' carefully — 'we immediately clicked' sounds slightly unnatural; prefer 'we clicked straight away' or 'we hit it off immediately'
V.es: Para acciones digitales: natural. Para conexión social: 'immediately clicked' suena algo forzado; mejor: 'we clicked straight away' o 'we hit it off immediately'
V.ex: I clicked the button immediately. / We hit it off immediately — clicked is better without 'quickly/immediately' in social contexts.
V.note: Key insight: adverb + 'clicked' works well for technology but sounds unnatural for social bonding

V.en: to take off the clothes you are wearing and put on different ones
V.es: Cambiarse de ropa
V.ex: I got home from the plant and changed clothes before dinner.
V.note: Se dice 'change clothes' o 'get changed', sin 'the'. Ortografía: clothes /kləʊðz/ (a menudo /kləʊz/), no 'clouths'. 'Change into' + prenda: 'She changed into something comfortable'. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: to put on your clothes, usually after waking up
V.es: Vestirse (acción básica, al levantarse)
V.ex: I got dressed and left for the plant at seven.
V.note: 'Get dressed' = vestirse por primera vez; 'change clothes' = cambiar la ropa que ya llevas. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: to defend yourself or perform well in a difficult situation, competing successfully against stronger or more experienced people
V.es: Defenderse bien; no dejarse avasallar; estar a la altura frente a alguien más fuerte o experimentado
V.ex: Despite being the youngest engineer, she can hold her own in technical meetings.
V.note: El posesivo cambia con el sujeto: hold my/his/their own. Implica no perder, no necesariamente ganar. Distinto de 'stand your ground'. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: in large quantities; (of goods) loose or unpackaged, handled as a whole
V.es: Al por mayor (comprar, vender) o a granel (transportar, almacenar)
V.ex: We buy ferric sulphate in bulk to reduce the unit price.
V.note: Sin artículo: 'in bulk', no 'in the bulk'. Distinto de 'the bulk of' (la mayor parte de) y 'bulky' (voluminoso). Colocaciones: bulk discount, bulk order, bulk storage. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: in a better situation (financially or otherwise); used to say what would be more advantageous
V.es: En mejor situación; te convendría más (hacer algo)
V.ex: You'd be better off replacing the pump than repairing it again.
V.note: Patrón útil: 'you'd be better off + -ing'. Comparativo de 'well off'. Clase 04/11/2026.

V.en: a weekend without special activities or events; relaxed and calm
V.es: Un fin de semana tranquilo
V.ex: I had a quiet weekend. I just stayed at home and relaxed.
V.note: Frase de la clase del 04/11/2026. Se puede ampliar con: 'I just stayed at home and relaxed'.

V.en: treated water discharged to the receiving water body
V.es: Efluente — agua tratada descargada al medio receptor
V.ex: The effluent from the WWTP met EU discharge standards for BOD and TSS.

V.en: raw incoming water or wastewater entering treatment
V.es: Afluente — agua bruta de entrada al sistema de tratamiento
V.ex: Influent BOD was measured at 350 mg/L during peak flow conditions.

V.en: chemical destabilisation of suspended colloidal particles
V.es: Coagulación — desestabilización química de partículas coloidales
V.ex: Ferric sulphate was applied for coagulation at the WTP at 40 mg/L dose.

V.en: aggregation of destabilised particles into larger settleable flocs
V.es: Floculación — agregación de partículas en flóculos sedimentables
V.ex: Gentle stirring during flocculation promotes floc growth and settling.

V.en: cloudiness of water due to suspended particles, measured in NTU
V.es: Turbidez — presencia de partículas en suspensión (en NTU)
V.ex: Turbidity was reduced from 45 to 0.3 NTU after rapid sand filtration.

V.en: measure of biodegradable organic pollution in water (mg/L)
V.es: DBO — medida de contaminación orgánica biodegradable del agua
V.ex: BOD₅ of the raw sewage was 280 mg/L; effluent target was <25 mg/L.

V.en: measure of total chemical oxygen demand in water (mg/L)
V.es: DQO — demanda química de oxígeno total del agua
V.ex: COD removal efficiency reached 92% after secondary biological treatment.

V.en: aerobic biological treatment using suspended microbial flocs
V.es: Lodos activos — tratamiento biológico aerobio en suspensión
V.ex: The activated sludge process operated at an SRT of 15 days.

V.en: biological oxidation of ammonia to nitrate by autotrophic bacteria
V.es: Nitrificación — oxidación biológica de amonio a nitrato
V.ex: Complete nitrification was achieved at 18°C with adequate dissolved oxygen.

V.en: biological reduction of nitrate to N₂ gas under anoxic conditions
V.es: Desnitrificación — reducción biológica de nitratos a N₂ en anoxia
V.ex: An anoxic zone was designed for denitrification upstream of the aerobic zone.

V.en: combined biological treatment and membrane filtration system
V.es: Biorreactor de membrana — combina biología y filtración por membrana
V.ex: The MBR produced effluent suitable for agricultural irrigation water reuse.

V.en: high-pressure membrane process for desalination or purification
V.es: Ósmosis inversa — separación a alta presión por membrana semipermeable
V.ex: RO was applied for desalination of brackish groundwater at the site.

V.en: pressure surge from sudden flow velocity changes in pipes
V.es: Golpe de ariete — sobrepresión por cierre brusco de válvulas
V.ex: Water hammer damaged the check valve after an emergency pump shutdown.

V.en: Net Positive Suction Head — pressure at pump inlet to prevent cavitation
V.es: ANPA — altura neta de aspiración positiva (parámetro anti-cavitación)
V.ex: Available NPSH must exceed required NPSH by a safety margin of at least 0.5 m.

V.en: water lost before reaching customers (leakage + apparent losses)
V.es: Agua no facturada — pérdidas reales y aparentes en la red de distribución
V.ex: NRW exceeded 35%, triggering a district metered area (DMA) audit.

V.en: water's capacity to neutralise acids (buffering capacity, mg/L CaCO₃)
V.es: Alcalinidad — capacidad tampón del agua para neutralizar ácidos
V.ex: Low alkalinity (<80 mg/L CaCO₃) inhibited nitrification in the bioreactor.

V.en: mean cell residence time of biomass in the biological system
V.es: TRS — tiempo de retención de lodos; edad del lodo en el sistema
V.ex: SRT was set at 20 days to ensure stable and complete nitrification.

V.en: energy loss due to friction and fittings in a pipe system (metres)
V.es: Pérdida de carga — energía perdida por rozamiento en tuberías
V.ex: Head loss across the rapid sand filter was 2.5 m at design flow.

V.en: total concentration of solids in suspension in water (mg/L)
V.es: SST — sólidos en suspensión totales del agua en mg/L
V.ex: TSS in the effluent must be below 35 mg/L per the discharge permit.

V.en: Enhanced Biological Phosphorus Removal using anaerobic/aerobic cycling
V.es: Eliminación biológica de fósforo potenciada — ciclo anaerobio/aerobio
V.ex: EBPR achieved effluent P concentrations consistently below 1 mg/L.

V.en: vehicle at the end of its operational life requiring managed disposal
V.es: VFU — Vehículo al Final de su Vida Útil (Dir. 2000/53/CE)
V.ex: Directive 2000/53/EC still governs ELV management until Regulation (EU) 2026/1738 starts to apply in 2028.

V.en: removal of all hazardous materials from a vehicle before dismantling
V.es: Descontaminación — extracción de materiales peligrosos del VFU
V.ex: Depollution includes draining all fluids, removing batteries and pyrotechnics.

V.en: official document confirming proper ELV end-of-life processing
V.es: Certificado de Destrucción — documento oficial de baja del VFU
V.ex: The CoD must be issued free of charge to the vehicle's last registered owner.

V.en: non-metallic residue from vehicle shredding (fluff)
V.es: Fluff — fracción no metálica residual del fragmentado del vehículo
V.ex: ASR contains plastics, foam and glass requiring landfill or thermal treatment.

V.en: emission control device with recoverable precious metals (Pt, Pd, Rh)
V.es: Catalizador — contiene metales preciosos (Pt, Pd, Rh) recuperables
V.ex: Catalytic converters are selectively dismantled before shredding.

V.en: mandatory extraction of HFCs from vehicle AC before shredding
V.es: Recuperación de refrigerantes — extracción obligatoria de HFCs del A/C
V.ex: Refrigerant recovery must be performed by a certified technician only.

V.en: airbags and seatbelt pretensioners requiring safe deactivation
V.es: Componentes pirotécnicos — airbags y pretensores a neutralizar
V.ex: Pyrotechnic components must be deactivated electrically or physically before shredding.

V.en: EU regulation controlling hazardous chemical substances in products
V.es: Reglamento REACH — control de sustancias peligrosas en la UE
V.ex: REACH restricts hazardous substances in vehicle components: Pb, Cd, Cr(VI), Hg.

V.en: manual removal of high-value or hazardous components before shredding
V.es: Desmontaje selectivo — extracción manual de componentes de valor
V.ex: Selective dismantling of electronics recovers rare earth materials.

V.en: waste requiring specialised management due to its dangerous properties
V.es: Residuo peligroso — exige gestión especializada por sus propiedades
V.ex: Used engine oil is classified as hazardous waste under EU Directive 2008/98/EC.

V.en: % of vehicle weight reused/recovered (EU target ≥95%, recycling ≥85%)
V.es: Tasa de reutilización/reciclaje — objetivo europeo del 95%/85% en peso
V.ex: EU ELV Directive requires 95% reuse/recovery and 85% reuse/recycling by weight.

V.en: iron-based metallic fraction recovered from vehicle shredding (~70% wt)
V.es: Chatarra férrica — fracción metálica principal del VFU (~70% del peso)
V.ex: Ferrous scrap is the primary economic output of ELV shredding operations.

V.en: aluminium, copper, zinc recovered from ELV dismantling and shredding
V.es: Metales no férricos — Al, Cu, Zn recuperados del desguace
V.ex: Non-ferrous metals have high economic value and are fully recyclable.

V.en: person or entity with an interest in a project or organisation
V.es: Parte interesada — actor con interés en un proyecto u organización
V.ex: Key stakeholders include local authorities, clients, and environmental regulators.

V.en: process of acquiring goods or services through competitive tendering
V.es: Contratación — proceso de obtención de bienes o servicios
V.ex: The procurement process must comply with EU public tender rules.

V.en: formal offer to supply goods or services at a stated price
V.es: Licitación — propuesta formal con precio para un contrato
V.ex: We submitted a tender for the WWTP upgrade project.

V.en: Key Performance Indicator — measurable value demonstrating achievement
V.es: Indicador Clave de Rendimiento — métrica de evaluación del desempeño
V.ex: Treatment efficiency and energy per m³ are core KPIs for the plant.

V.en: thorough investigation or audit carried out before a business decision
V.es: Diligencia debida — auditoría exhaustiva previa a una decisión clave
V.ex: Environmental due diligence was conducted before acquiring the site.

V.en: conformity with laws, regulations, or contractual requirements
V.es: Cumplimiento normativo — conformidad con leyes y requisitos legales
V.ex: Regulatory compliance with IED and WFD is non-negotiable for our plant.

V.en: formal description of all work to be performed under a contract
V.es: Alcance del trabajo — descripción detallada del trabajo contratado
V.ex: The scope of work clearly defined the contractor's obligations and deliverables.

V.en: standard reference point used to measure and compare performance
V.es: Referencia comparativa — valor estándar para evaluar el rendimiento
V.ex: We benchmarked our energy consumption against EU BREF best practices.

V.en: specific tangible output of a project, milestone, or contract
V.es: Entregable — resultado tangible y verificable de un proyecto
V.ex: The final deliverable was a detailed technical feasibility report.

V.en: non-binding agreement outlining terms of cooperation between parties
V.es: Memorando de Entendimiento — acuerdo marco no vinculante entre partes
V.ex: An MoU was signed with the municipality for biogas utilisation from the WWTP.

V.en: formal document presenting findings, analysis and recommendations
V.es: Informe técnico — documento formal con análisis y conclusiones
V.ex: A technical report was submitted to the environmental competent authority.

V.en: concise overview of a longer document for senior decision-makers
V.es: Resumen ejecutivo — síntesis del documento para la alta dirección
V.ex: The executive summary highlighted key treatment performance results.

V.en: supplementary material placed at the end of a technical document
V.es: Anexo — material complementario al final del informe técnico
V.ex: Raw analytical data and calibration certificates were included in the appendix.

V.en: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram — shows all process equipment and instruments
V.es: Diagrama de tuberías e instrumentación — plano de referencia del proceso
V.ex: The P&ID showed all valves, sensors and control loops in the treatment plant.

V.en: document defining objectives, scope and responsibilities of a project
V.es: Términos de referencia — define objetivos, alcance y responsabilidades
V.ex: The ToR was prepared for the environmental impact assessment (EIA).

V.en: final approved drawing or document ready for construction use
V.es: Emitido para Construcción — estado final y aprobado de un documento
V.ex: All drawings were stamped IFC before civil works commenced on site.

V.en: detailed technical description of materials, methods and performance requirements
V.es: Especificación técnica — descripción detallada de requisitos y materiales
V.ex: The equipment specification defined all performance guarantees and warranties.

V.en: brief summary of a scientific paper or technical report (150–300 words)
V.es: Resumen / Abstract — síntesis de un artículo o informe científico
V.ex: The abstract summarised the main findings of the water quality modelling study.

V.en: structured list of items to be discussed during a meeting
V.es: Orden del día — lista estructurada de temas de la reunión
V.ex: Please review the agenda before tomorrow's technical coordination meeting.

V.en: official written record of a meeting's proceedings and decisions
V.es: Acta de reunión — registro oficial de lo tratado y acordado
V.ex: The minutes were circulated to all attendees within 24 hours.

V.en: specific tasks assigned to individuals during a meeting with deadlines
V.es: Compromisos / tareas — acciones asignadas con responsable y plazo
V.ex: The action items included submitting the ELV compliance report by Friday.

V.en: subsequent action or communication after an initial contact or meeting
V.es: Seguimiento — acción posterior a una reunión o contacto inicial
V.ex: I will follow up on the permit renewal application next week.

V.en: final agenda item for topics not covered elsewhere in the meeting
V.es: Ruegos y preguntas — último punto del orden del día
V.ex: Under AOB, the team raised the issue of the delayed equipment delivery.

V.en: minimum number of people required for a meeting to be officially valid
V.es: Quórum — número mínimo de asistentes para validez de la reunión
V.ex: The meeting could not proceed as there was no quorum present.

V.en: person who leads, moderates and facilitates a meeting
V.es: Presidente / Moderador — quien dirige y modera la reunión
V.ex: As chairperson, she kept the technical discussion on track and on time.

V.en: general agreement reached among all members of a group
V.es: Consenso — acuerdo general entre todos los miembros del grupo
V.ex: The team reached consensus on the wastewater treatment technology selection.

V.en: short informational meeting to update a team or group
V.es: Sesión informativa breve — reunión corta de puesta al día
V.ex: A daily site briefing was held each morning to track construction progress.

V.en: telephone or video meeting connecting participants in different locations
V.es: Conferencia / Videollamada — reunión a distancia con múltiples sedes
V.ex: We held a conference call with the Barcelona supplier to review the tender.

V.en: Use 'since' with a point in time and 'for' with a duration, usually with the present perfect
V.es: 'Since' con un punto de inicio en el tiempo; 'for' con una duración. Normalmente con present perfect
V.ex: The digester has been running since March / for eight months without a major stoppage.
V.rule: ✓ since + 2019 / Monday / the upgrade | ✓ for + three years / two weeks | ✗ NOT 'since three years'

V.en: Present perfect links a past action to now (no finished time stated); past simple refers to a finished, specified time
V.es: El present perfect conecta el pasado con el presente (sin tiempo terminado); el past simple se usa con un momento pasado concreto y cerrado
V.ex: We have reduced energy consumption by 12% this year. We replaced the blowers in 2024.
V.rule: ✓ have + participle: this year, so far, already, yet | ✓ past simple: yesterday, in 2024, last month | ✗ NOT 'We have replaced them in 2024'

V.en: Many technical nouns are uncountable in English: no plural -s and no 'a/an'; use 'a piece of', 'an item of', 'some' or a unit
V.es: Muchos sustantivos técnicos son incontables en inglés: sin plural en -s ni 'a/an'; se usa 'a piece of', 'an item of', 'some' o una unidad
V.ex: The contractor delivered the equipment on Monday, but we still need more information about sludge disposal.
V.rule: ✓ equipment, information, advice, sludge, waste, feedback, research | ✓ two items of equipment, 30 tonnes of sludge | ✗ NOT 'equipments', 'informations', 'an advice'
V.note: 'Data' takes either singular or plural verb in technical English: 'the data is/are'.

V.en: 'Affect' is normally a verb (to influence); 'effect' is normally a noun (the result). 'To effect' as a verb means to bring about
V.es: 'Affect' suele ser verbo (influir/afectar); 'effect' suele ser sustantivo (efecto/resultado). 'To effect' como verbo significa llevar a cabo
V.ex: Low temperatures affect nitrification; the effect is a rise in effluent ammonia.
V.rule: ✓ X affects Y | ✓ X has an effect on Y | ✓ to effect a change (formal) | ✗ NOT 'has an affect on'

V.en: Use the passive (be + past participle) when the action or result matters more than who did it, e.g. in methods and reports
V.es: Se usa la pasiva (be + participio) cuando importa la acción o el resultado más que quién la realiza, p. ej. en métodos e informes
V.ex: Samples were collected every two hours and analysed for COD and ammonium.
V.rule: ✓ Methods, procedures, results | ✓ add 'by + agent' only if relevant | ✗ Avoid long chains of passives in emails: prefer 'we' for actions and commitments

V.en: document describing step by step how a specific task will be carried out safely, with resources, hazards and controls
V.es: Procedimiento de trabajo — documento que describe paso a paso cómo se ejecutará una tarea de forma segura, con medios, riesgos y medidas de control
V.ex: The contractor must submit a method statement before entering the digester for cleaning.

V.en: final drawings showing the installation exactly as it was constructed, including changes made on site
V.es: Planos as-built / de obra ejecutada — reflejan la instalación tal como se construyó, con los cambios hechos en obra
V.ex: Handover will not be accepted until the as-built drawings of the new pumping station are delivered.

V.en: Operation and Maintenance manual: instructions for operating, maintaining and troubleshooting a plant or equipment
V.es: Manual de operación y mantenimiento (O&M) — instrucciones para operar, mantener y resolver averías de una planta o equipo
V.ex: Check the O&M manual for the recommended backwash frequency of the sand filters.

V.en: document summarising the technical characteristics and performance of a product or component
V.es: Hoja de datos / ficha técnica — resume las características técnicas y prestaciones de un producto o componente
V.ex: Please attach the datasheet of the proposed blower, including power consumption at the duty point.

V.en: large machine that tears depolluted vehicle hulks and scrap into small fragments so that metals can be separated
V.es: Fragmentadora (shredder) — máquina que tritura carrocerías descontaminadas y chatarra para separar los metales
V.ex: Depolluted hulks are compacted and sent to the shredder, where ferrous metals are recovered magnetically.

V.en: the remaining body shell of a vehicle after depollution and removal of reusable parts
V.es: Carrocería / casco del vehículo — lo que queda tras la descontaminación y el desmontaje de piezas
V.ex: We compacted forty hulks this week before shipping them to the shredding plant.

V.en: high-voltage battery that powers an electric or hybrid vehicle; it must be isolated and removed by trained staff
V.es: Batería de tracción — batería de alta tensión de vehículos eléctricos o híbridos; debe aislarse y extraerse por personal formado
V.ex: Before dismantling the hybrid, the technician checked that the traction battery was isolated and wore insulated gloves.

V.en: components removed from end-of-life vehicles, checked and sold for reuse in other vehicles
V.es: Piezas de segunda mano / recuperadas — componentes extraídos de VFU, revisados y vendidos para su reutilización
V.ex: Sales of used spare parts such as alternators and headlamps now cover a large share of the yard's revenue.

V.en: policy principle that makes producers financially and organisationally responsible for their products when they become waste
V.es: Responsabilidad ampliada del productor (RAP) — obliga a los productores a responsabilizarse, financiera y organizativamente, de sus productos cuando se convierten en residuo
V.ex: Under Regulation (EU) 2026/1738, vehicle producers will finance the take-back and treatment of end-of-life vehicles through EPR.

V.en: reduction of the water content of sludge by mechanical means (centrifuge, belt or screw press) to cut its volume
V.es: Deshidratación de fangos — reducción del contenido de agua del fango por medios mecánicos (centrífuga, filtro banda o tornillo) para reducir su volumen
V.ex: After upgrading the centrifuge, sludge dewatering reached 24% dry solids and transport costs fell.

V.en: biological breakdown of organic matter without oxygen, producing biogas (mainly methane and CO₂) and stabilised sludge
V.es: Digestión anaerobia — degradación biológica de la materia orgánica sin oxígeno que produce biogás (principalmente metano y CO₂) y fango estabilizado
V.ex: Anaerobic digestion at the WWTP produces enough biogas to cover a large part of the plant's electricity demand.

V.en: cogeneration: simultaneous production of electricity and useful heat from one fuel, such as biogas
V.es: Cogeneración — producción simultánea de electricidad y calor útil a partir de un combustible, como el biogás
V.ex: Heat recovered from the CHP engine keeps the digesters at mesophilic temperature.

V.en: advanced treatment stage that removes a broad range of micropollutants (e.g. pharmaceuticals) from urban wastewater, typically by ozonation or activated carbon
V.es: Tratamiento cuaternario — etapa avanzada que elimina un amplio espectro de microcontaminantes (p. ej. fármacos) de las aguas residuales urbanas, normalmente mediante ozono o carbón activo
V.ex: Directive (EU) 2024/3019 requires quaternary treatment in plants of 150,000 p.e. and above, phased in up to 2045.

V.en: situation in which the renewable energy produced (on or off site) equals the total annual energy used by the treatment plants
V.es: Neutralidad energética — la energía renovable producida (in situ o fuera) iguala el consumo energético anual total de las depuradoras
V.ex: The recast Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive sets a national energy neutrality target for plants of 10,000 p.e. and above by 2045.

V.en: concentration of chlorine remaining in treated water after the contact time, which protects it in the distribution network
V.es: Cloro residual — concentración de cloro que queda en el agua tratada tras el tiempo de contacto y la protege en la red de distribución
V.ex: Free chlorine residual at the end of the network dropped, so we increased the dose at the reservoir outlet.
